prompt: This landing page repeats the same brand colors as hex codes throughout the stylesheet. Add a dark theme -- however the toggle happens, a media query or a class or attribute -- without repeating the whole color palette a second time for the dark variant.
expected_output: Colors move into custom properties declared once (for example in :root) and consumed with var(...); the dark variant overrides those same custom property names instead of duplicating every rule; the markup and existing classes keep working.

expectations.text: Colors are declared once as custom properties
Existing rules consume the custom properties with var()
A dark variant is defined by a media query or a class/attribute
Nothing new lands at the repository root
